page.overview:
Who is Evan?

Evan is a major character in The Real Jake, the second story of Fazbear Frights 6: Blackbird. He was a caring father who tried looking after his son, Jake, while also serving as overseas as a soldier. He was also the secret identity of Simon, a pretend friend that "lived" in a cabinet in Jake's room.

Evan was described as a man with a buzz cut.

Evan is a confident and determined man who tries to stay optimistic, always giving positive encouragement. He's also rather charming and can make others laugh easily. Evan can be rather superstitious, believing that love and intention can give life. He also has an insatiable desire for knowledge, owning many fiction and non-fiction books of different genres.

After his wife's death, Evan's son suffered brain tumor and he has to call him almost every day. First few months later, Evan gave his son a positive encouragement in hopes to get the brain tumor cured, saying "Keep your chin up," and Jake gleefully accept it. However, the surgery is unsuccessful and Jake has to go through radiation and chemotherapy, and he thus starting to get sullen. Evan tried to encourage Jake for months but he kept refusing to accept the cheer. Evan decided that Jake needed to believe in someone who could pull him out of the horror of his daily life and lead him into the joy of different possibilities, and thus "Simon" was born. Using a backup monitor linked to a hidden one inside the cabinet in Jake's room, Margie would call Evan and have him speak to Jake as Simon. Evan decides that Jake would respond more to someone his own age, so he uses a voice distorter to turn his voice into that of a little kid's.
